title: Fix creation of `move_mask` for `write_extxyz` to fix #1753 and #1754
body:
This is on top of !3808 marked as draft until that MR is merged.

Closes #1753, #1754

This MR fixes the above two issues by fixing the creation of `move_mask`.

New tests are added, and wrong tests are fixed.
